theorems.name: Submission.tae_whitney_c1_extension
theorems.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (A : Set (Rn n)) (h : Rn n → ℝ) (D : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] ℝ)), IsClosed A → ContinuousOn h A → ContinuousOn D A → (∀ Q : Set (Rn n), IsCompact Q → Q ⊆ A → ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∀ x ∈ Q, ∀ y ∈ A, dist x y < ρ → ‖h y - h x - D x (y - x)‖ ≤ η * ‖y - x‖) → ∃ g : Rn n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 g ∧ (∀ a ∈ A, g a = h a) ∧ ∀ a ∈ A, HasFDerivAt g (D a) a
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
